description: This Java class 'PoliciesValidator' validates policies by checking if at least one subject has the required permissions on the root resource. It implements the Validator interface and provides methods to create instances, validate policies, and retrieve validation reasons.

classes.name: PoliciesValidator
classes.description: A final class that validates policies to ensure at least one subject has the minimum required permissions on the root resource.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of PoliciesValidator with the provided policy entries.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Performs validation to check if policies contain at least one subject with required permissions.

methods.name: getReason
methods.description: Returns an optional reason string if validation fails.

methods.name: hasPermissionGranted
methods.description: Checks if a policy entry grants the required permissions on the root resource.

methods.name: hasPermissionRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a policy entry revokes the required permissions on the root resource.
